paite: "Hiai bang in Bezaleel, Aholiab leh mun siangthou vanzatte bawldan ding thei ding a TOUPA'N pilna leh theihsiamna a piak khutsiamte'n TOUPA thupiak bang in vanzatte abawl ding uh ahi,” achi hi.
english: “Bezalel and Oholiab shall work with every wise-hearted man, in whom Yahweh has put wisdom and understanding to know how to do all the work for the service of the sanctuary, according to all that Yahweh has commanded.”

paite: Huai khit in Mosi in Bezaleel, Aholiab leh michih khutsiamna nei, alungtang ua TOUPA'N pilna akoih leh michih alungtang ua nasem a kuan dia tohthoh a omte Mosi in asamta hi.
heading: Mite'n Thilpiak Tampi Atawi Uh
english: Moses called Bezalel and Oholiab, and every wise-hearted man, in whose heart Yahweh had put wisdom, even everyone whose heart stirred him up to come to the work to do it.

paite: Amaute'n mun siangthou bawlna dia Israel suante'n ahon tawi uh thilpiak tengteng Mosi a pan alata uhi. Huchi in zingsang teng in ut thu apiak thillatte akiang ah hon tawi uhi.
english: They received from Moses all the offering which the children of Israel had brought for the work of the service of the sanctuary, with which to make it. They kept bringing free will offerings to him every morning.

paite: Mun siangthou a nna tengteng sem, khutsiam teng a nasep chiat a pan ahong pai ua,
english: All the wise men, who performed all the work of the sanctuary, each came from his work which he did.

paite: Mosi kiang ah, "TOUPA'N bawl dia ahon thupiak bang a nasepna dia poimoh zah sang a tamzaw mite'n ahon tawi uh," achi uhi.
english: They spoke to Moses, saying, “The people have brought much more than enough for the service of the work which Yahweh commanded to make.”

paite: Mosi in thu apia a, giahphual teng ah atangkoupih ua, "Pasal hileh numei hileh mun siangthou bawlna dia thilpiak kuamah in pe nawn kei un," achi hi. Huchi in thilpiak hon tawi nawn lou dia kham in a-omta uhi.
english: Moses gave a commandment, and they caused it to be proclaimed throughout the camp, saying, “Let neither man nor woman make anything else for the offering for the sanctuary.” So the people were restrained from bringing.

paite: Mun siangthou bawlna a nna tengteng sepna ding in avan neihsa uh kiching in, atam lota hi.
english: For the stuff they had was sufficient to do all the work, and too much.

paite: Nasemte lak a khutsiamte'n biakbuk khuhna ding siamtak a khui cherubte lim tuanna puanzak sawm, khau dum, khau sandup leh khau san-au khuk in abawl uhi.
heading: TOUPA Omna Puanin Bawlna / (Eks 26.1-37)
english: All the wise-hearted men among those who did the work made the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twined linen, blue, purple, and scarlet. They made them with cherubim, the work of a skillful workman.

paite: Puanzak khat dunglam tong sawmnih-le-giat ahi a; availam tong li; puanzak tengteng letdan akikim chiat hi.
english: The length of each curtain was twenty-eight cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits. All the curtains had one measure.

paite: Puanzak ngate kithuah in akhep uhi. Puanzak dang ngate leng akhep hi.
english: He coupled five curtains to one another, and the other five curtains he coupled to one another.

paite: Akithuahna mong khepna a pan puanzak khat gei ah khau dum in abilte abawl a, huchi mah in anihna khepna ah, puanzak dang gei chin ah abilte abawl hi.
english: He made loops of blue on the edge of the one curtain from the edge in the coupling. Likewise he made in the edge of the curtain that was outermost in the second coupling.

paite: Puanzak khat ah abil sawmnga abawl a, anihna kikhepna a puanzak gei ah abil sawmnga abawl hi. Abilte kizawn geihgeih in a-om uhi.
english: He made fifty loops in the one curtain, and he made fifty loops in the edge of the curtain that was in the second coupling. The loops were opposite to one another.

paite: Dangka-eng in kilhna sawmnga abawl a, kilhnate in puanzakte agawmkhawm hi. Huchi in biakbuk khat ahong hita hi.
english: He made fifty clasps of gold, and coupled the curtains to one another with the clasps: so the tabernacle was a unit.

paite: Puanin biakbuk tung a ding in kel mul in puanzak abawl a; sawm-le-khat abawl hi.
english: He made curtains of goats’ hair for a covering over the tabernacle. He made them eleven curtains.

paite: Puanzak khat dunglam tong sawmthum ahi a, puanzak khat vailam tong li ahi. Puanzak sawm-le-khatte alehlam akibang vek hi.
english: The length of each curtain was thirty cubits, and four cubits the width of each curtain. The eleven curtains had one measure.

paite: Puanzak ngate amau in akikheptuam a, puanzak gukte amau in akikheptuam hi.
english: He coupled five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves.

paite: Akikhepna puanzak mongchin ah abil sawmnga abawl a, puanzak anihna thuahna pen mong ah abil sawmnga abawl hi.
english: He made fifty loops on the edge of the curtain that was outermost in the coupling, and he made fifty loops on the edge of the curtain which was outermost in the second coupling.

paite: Khat ahihtheihna dia puanin kaihkhawmna ding in dal in kilhna sawmnga abawl hi.
english: He made fifty clasps of bronze to couple the tent together, that it might be a unit.

paite: Puanin khuhna ding in belampa vun diahsan in abawl a, huai tung ah ngalvang vun in khuhna abawl hi.
english: He made a covering for the tent of rams’ skins dyed red, and a covering of sea cow hides above.

paite: Singgi sing in biakbuk singpek ding atunthoh in abawl hi.
english: He made the boards for the tabernacle of acacia wood, standing up.

paite: Singpek sau lam tong sawm ahi a, singpek zatlam tong khat-le-akim ahi.
english: Ten cubits was the length of a board, and a cubit and a half the width of each board.

paite: Singpek khat in atgek nih anei a, akigamlatdan uh kikim in huchibang in biakbuk singpek tengteng a ding in abawl hi.
english: Each board had two tenons, joined to one another. He made all the boards of the tabernacle this way.

paite: Biakbuk a ding in singpek abawl a, simlam pang a ding in singpek sawmnih abawl hi.
english: He made the boards for the tabernacle, twenty boards for the south side southward.

paite: Singpek sawmnih nuai ah dangka-eng in kingakna khuakkuak sawmli abawl a; a-atgek nihte a ding in singpek khat dang ah kingakna khuakkuak nih, a-atgek nih a ding in singpek dang ah kingakna khuakkuak nih abawl hi.
english: He made forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards: two sockets under one board for its two tenons, and two sockets under another board for its two tenons.

paite: Biakbuk pang khat lam a ding in, amallam ning a om a ding in singpek sawmnih,
english: For the second side of the tabernacle, on the north side, he made twenty boards

paite: adangka-eng kingakna khuakkuak sawmlite toh; singpek khat dang ah kingakna khuakkuak nih, singpek dang khat ah kingakna khuakkuak nih abawl hi.
english: and their forty sockets of silver: two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.

paite: Tumlam biakbuk pangte a ding in singpek nih abawl hi.
english: For the far part of the tabernacle westward he made six boards.

paite: Apang nihte ah biakbuk ningte a ding in singpek nih abawl hi.
english: He made two boards for the corners of the tabernacle in the far part.

paite: Anuai ah akithuah ua, atung ah sikkual khat ah akikaikhawm a; huchibang in aning tuak ah ahih tuaktuak hi.
english: They were double beneath, and in the same way they were all the way to its top to one ring. He did this to both of them in the two corners.

paite: Singpek giat a-om a; akingakna khuakkuak uh, dangka a bawl kingakna khuakkuak sawm-le-guk ahi ua, singpek chih dang ah kingakna khuakkuak nih abawl hi.
english: There were eight boards and their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets—under every board two sockets.

paite: Singgi sing chiangtawn abawl a, biakbuk pang khat a singpekte a ding in nga abawl hi.
english: He made bars of acacia wood: five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,

paite: Biakbuk pang dang a singpekte a ding in chiangtawn nga abawl a, tumlam pang a biakbuk singpekte a ding in chiangtawn nga abawl hi.
english: and five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the tabernacle for the hinder part westward.

paite: Chiangtawn laita pen singpekte khat a pan adang kap paisuak in abawl hi.
english: He made the middle bar to pass through in the middle of the boards from the one end to the other.

paite: Singpekte dangka-eng in aluan a, adangka-eng sikkualte chiangtawn omna ding in abawl a, chiangtawnte dangka-eng in aluan hi.
english: He overlaid the boards with gold, and made their rings of gold as places for the bars, and overlaid the bars with gold.

paite: Khau dum, khau sandup, khau san-au leh puanmalngat koptah hoih in puankhai abawl a; khutsiamtak in cherubte abawl hi.
english: He made the veil of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, with cherubim. He made it the work of a skillful workman.

paite: Singgi sing in khuam li abawl a; dangka-eng in aluan a, abannate dangka-eng abawl hi. Huaite a ding in dangka in kingakna khuakkuak li asung hi.
english: He made four pillars of acacia for it, and overlaid them with gold. Their hooks were of gold. He cast four sockets of silver for them.

paite: Biakbuk kongkhak a ding in khau dum, khau sandup, khau san-au leh puanmalngat hoih koptah, phim a khui in puankhai abawl hi.
english: He made a screen for the door of the tent, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of an embroiderer;

paite: Akhuam ngate abanna uh toh; azingte uleh apuanduangte dangka-eng in aluan a, himahleh akingakna khuakkuak ngate dal a bawl ahi.
english: and the five pillars of it with their hooks. He overlaid their capitals and their fillets with gold, and their five sockets were of bronze.
